privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.html:
Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how Studio SriRona (“SriRona”, “we”) collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you visit this website, fill in our contact form, or get in touch with us. We handle personal data in line with Indonesia’s Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 27 of 2022).

Information We Collect

We only collect what you choose to share with us:

  • Your name, email address, and phone number (optional) from the contact form
  • The content of your message, and any project information you send us by email or direct message

This website does not use analytics tools, advertising trackers, or cookies to track you. Our hosting provider may keep standard technical logs (such as IP address and browser type) to keep the site running securely.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Reply to your inquiry and discuss your needs
  • Prepare proposals and run projects we agree on together
  • Keep a record of our communication

We do not sell or rent your personal data, and we do not use it for marketing without your consent.

Third-Party Services

We rely on a few trusted services to run this website and to communicate with you:

  • Web3Forms, which delivers contact form submissions to our email
  • Google (Gmail), where we receive and reply to messages
  • Vercel, which hosts this website

These services process data in line with their own privacy policies. Links to Instagram and LinkedIn take you to those platforms, which have their own policies.

Retention and Security

We keep your messages for as long as needed to respond to you, run our work together, and keep reasonable business records. We take reasonable steps to protect your data from unauthorized access, but no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

Your Rights

You can ask us to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Correct or update it
  • Delete it, or stop using it

Send your request to studiosrirona@gmail.com, and we will respond as soon as we can.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version, with its date, is always on this page.

id.title: Kebijakan Privasi
id.html:
Pendahuluan

Kebijakan Privasi ini menjelaskan bagaimana Studio SriRona (“SriRona”, “kami”) mengumpulkan, menggunakan, dan melindungi data pribadimu saat kamu mengunjungi situs ini, mengisi formulir kontak, atau menghubungi kami. Kami mengelola data pribadi sesuai Undang-Undang Pelindungan Data Pribadi (UU No. 27 Tahun 2022).

Data yang Kami Kumpulkan

Kami hanya mengumpulkan data yang kamu pilih untuk dibagikan kepada kami:

  • Nama, alamat email, dan nomor telepon (opsional) dari formulir kontak
  • Isi pesanmu, serta informasi proyek yang kamu kirim lewat email atau pesan langsung

Situs ini tidak memakai alat analitik, pelacak iklan, atau cookie untuk melacakmu. Penyedia hosting kami dapat menyimpan log teknis standar (seperti alamat IP dan jenis browser) agar situs tetap berjalan dengan aman.

Cara Kami Menggunakan Datamu

Kami menggunakan datamu untuk:

  • Membalas pertanyaanmu dan mendiskusikan kebutuhanmu
  • Menyusun penawaran dan menjalankan proyek yang kita sepakati bersama
  • Menyimpan catatan komunikasi kita

Kami tidak menjual atau menyewakan data pribadimu, dan tidak menggunakannya untuk pemasaran tanpa persetujuanmu.

Layanan Pihak Ketiga

Kami mengandalkan beberapa layanan tepercaya untuk menjalankan situs ini dan berkomunikasi denganmu:

  • Web3Forms, yang meneruskan isian formulir kontak ke email kami
  • Google (Gmail), tempat kami menerima dan membalas pesan
  • Vercel, yang menjadi hosting situs ini

Layanan tersebut memproses data sesuai kebijakan privasi masing-masing. Tautan ke Instagram dan LinkedIn membawamu ke platform tersebut, yang memiliki kebijakannya sendiri.

Penyimpanan dan Keamanan

Kami menyimpan pesanmu selama dibutuhkan untuk membalasmu, menjalankan kerja sama kita, dan menyimpan catatan bisnis yang wajar. Kami mengambil langkah yang wajar untuk melindungi datamu dari akses tanpa izin, tetapi tidak ada metode pengiriman lewat internet yang sepenuhnya aman.

Hak-Hakmu

Kamu dapat meminta kami untuk:

  • Mengakses data pribadimu yang kami simpan
  • Memperbaiki atau memperbaruinya
  • Menghapusnya, atau berhenti menggunakannya

Kirim permintaanmu ke studiosrirona@gmail.com, dan kami akan menanggapinya secepatnya.

Perubahan Kebijakan

Kami dapat memperbarui Kebijakan Privasi ini dari waktu ke waktu. Versi terbaru beserta tanggalnya selalu ada di halaman ini.

terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service
terms-of-service.html:
Introduction

These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your use of services provided by Pulma (“we”, “us”, or “our”). By engaging with our services, you agree to these Terms in full.

Scope of Services

Pulma provides design and development services, including but not limited to product design, brand design, web development, and Framer development.

The scope of each project will be defined and agreed upon prior to the start of work. Any additional requests outside the agreed scope may require separate approval and adjustment.

Engagement & Communication

All projects begin with an initial alignment phase to define goals, timelines, and deliverables.

Communication will primarily take place through agreed channels such as email, messaging platforms, or scheduled calls. Timely feedback is essential to ensure smooth progress.

Payment Terms

Services are billed on a monthly or yearly basis, depending on the selected plan.

  • Monthly plans are billed in advance and renew automatically unless canceled
  • Yearly plans are billed upfront and reflect a reduced monthly rate
  • All payments are non-refundable unless otherwise agreed

Late payments may result in a pause or delay in services.

Revisions & Feedback

We offer unlimited revisions as part of our process, ensuring the final outcome aligns clearly with your goals.

Revisions are handled in a focused and structured manner. Feedback should be clear, consolidated, and provided within a reasonable timeframe to maintain steady progress and avoid unnecessary delays.

Intellectual Property

Upon full payment, final deliverables will be transferred to the client.

Pulma retains the right to showcase completed work for portfolio and promotional purposes, unless otherwise agreed.

Changes to Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of our services indicates acceptance of any updates.
